ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Idle` in both charts. `ready` is true from the start; only `GuardedJoin`'s join reads it.

`start`: both charts enter `Work`, and `Begin` → `Done` fires at once, so `Work` terminates in its entry tick. `PlainJoin`'s join has no trigger, so it is immediate: it fires now, sets `left` and ends in `After`. `GuardedJoin`'s `if ready` makes its join delayed, so it is not checked in `Work`'s entry tick: `left` stays false.
`GuardedJoin`'s join is checked for the first time: `Work` is still terminated and `ready` still true, so it fires and sets `left`. Both charts are now in `After`, one tick apart.
